newsitem.title: USA: Reebok sees modest decline in US Footwear backlog.
newsitem.headline: Reebok sees modest decline in US Footwear backlog.

text.p: Reebok International Ltd said Thursday it saw a modest decline in U.S. footwear backlog for the first quarter of 1997 and an increase for the second quarter of the year after the backlog rose 6.0 percent for the first two quarters of 1997.
The company's total backlog of open customer orders to be delivered from January 1997 through June 1997 for the Reebok brand was up 11.7 percent at December 31, 1996.
North American backlog was up 14.9 percent and international backlog was up 7.1 percent.

The company said it has elected to make in February of 1997 a $50 million prepayment on the $640 million six-year term facility that it entered into to fund the Dutch Auction share repurchase in August 1996.
